writeContract.saveProfile: fill settings-fullname/settings-email then settings-save-profile -> .alert.alert-success[data-testid=settings-success] 'Profile details saved successfully.' and value persists to /auth/profile identity card
writeContract.savePreferences: toggle pref-*-toggle(s) then settings-save-prefs -> same success alert style 'Notification preferences saved.'
writeContract.cleanupNote: test writes on staging leave residue; original seeded values are restored after the live probe. reset-state / /debug/reset is the official reseed path but is data-destroying -> out of scope per restrictions
writeContract.passwordChange: NOT automated — no approved state recipe to restore the seeded password; out of scope
writeContract.dangerZone: delete-account / revoke-all — destructive or session-affecting; NOT automated
